summary: Read a list of integers that may include negative values. Choose one contiguous span from the list. The span has to keep at least one value. Add the integers inside the span and write the largest total that any allowed span can produce. When every integer is negative, the answer is the greatest single integer in the list. Write the total only, not the endpoint indexes of the span.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
